summary.intent: Address all 13 PR review threads for cipher-box PR #372 and fix a resulting CI test failure in the IPNS service spec.
summary.outcome: All 13 review threads were resolved (8 fixed, 1 already addressed, 4 not applicable), and the broken IpnsService unit test was fixed by adding a missing SharesService mock provider.

repo: IpnsModule imports SharesModule (for findActiveWriteShare), so IpnsService has a SharesService dependency that must be provided in unit test modules.

PR #372 review items included: DTO validation, duplicate FolderIpns guard, fail-closed auth, atomic downgrade, drag/drop preventDefault, action button locking, key zeroing in finally, and addShareKeys error surfacing.
Several patterns were intentionally left as-is: reWrap before publish (pre-existing), 100-share poll limit (PoC scope), file-ipns re-wrap (by design).

code.finding: Test module was missing SharesService in providers after IpnsModule gained a SharesModule dependency. Required adding a SharesService mock to the RootTestModule providers to resolve Nest DI error.

workflow: When a module adds an import (e.g. SharesModule), all existing unit tests for services in that module must be updated to provide the new dependency.
CI job URLs can be used with gh CLI to fetch structured failure logs for quick diagnosis.

friction: Adding SharesModule to IpnsModule silently broke the IpnsService unit test — the dependency change was not caught before push, requiring a follow-up CI fix commit.
open_items: 100-share poll limit deferred as PoC scope — should be revisited before production.
reWrap before publish is a pre-existing pattern flagged in review but not changed — may need future cleanup.
file-ipns re-wrap behavior is by design but was flagged in review — worth documenting intent explicitly.
